test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word from the given options that can substitute the word 'courage' and make a meaningful sentence.

I am not courage enough to take this risk.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. courageous .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence needs an adjective to describe the subject's quality of having courage. The correct adjective form of "courage" is "courageous."
 
• Using "courageous" makes the sentence grammatically correct and meaningful.
 
• The other options (encourage, discouraging, discourage) are either verbs or adverbs and do not fit the context of needing an adjective.

Correct sentence: *I am not **courageous** enough to take this risk*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Word Forms and Usage:**

 
 
• **Courage:** Noun - the ability to do something that frightens one.
 
• **Courageous:** Adjective - possessing or displaying courage.
 
• **Encourage:** Verb - give support, confidence, or hope to (someone).
 
• **Discouraging:** Adjective - causing someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm.
 
• **Discourage:** Verb - cause (someone) to lose confidence or enthusiasm.
